text:
maria: FYI rolled AWQ-quantized v2 -> canary at 10% earlier and started seeing sporadic decoding artifacts and a small spike in user-side perplexity :thinking_face:

sandeep: ugh, what kind of artifacts? logs?

maria: short snippets of repeated tokens on long contexts, plus some prompts that used to return factual answers are hallucinating the year. Example from logs:
```
INFER: prompt=\"System: summarize...\"
OUTPUT: \"...2022 2022 2022\"
KV-ERR: cache_mismatch at layer 8 seq 512
```

alex: repo + model config? were act-quant enabled?

maria: config used for canary: `awq: {group_size: 128, act_quant: true, block_bits: 4}`. Canary image tag `awq-v2-canary-2026-06-03`. Serving runtime shows occasional `KV cache mismatch` warnings and per-token latency jumps.

hao: interesting. on my local sim, reducing group_size to 64 stabilizes generation but increases 1.5x memory and ~8% slower per-token. Did you run eval-bot on the canary?

maria: yeah attached eval run (small set) — eval-bot: 
- accuracy_delta (vs float32): -0.9% on TriviaQA
- rouge drop ~0.6
- failure modes: repeated tokens, occasional OOV-like tokens

eval-bot: quick note: evaluation harness flagged higher variance for `group_size>=128` with `act_quant=true`. Distribution of token-level logprob has heavier tail.

sandeep: could be numerical instability from activation quantization accumulation across layers. Did we try `act_quant=false` but keep weight AWQ?

maria: not yet on canary. I can spin a 5% canary with `act_quant=false`, `group_size=128` to isolate.

alex: also test `group_size=32` + `act_quant=true` — sometimes smaller groups reduce cross-token quantization error at cost of more metadata.

hao: there was a known issue where KV cache serialization assumed fp16 intermediate; AWQ changes layout slightly and edge-case seq_len boundaries triggered mismatch. PR #412 in runtime touched that. Could be related.

maria: stack trace from one failing pod: `runtime/infer.go:452: kv_apply: invalid slot length for layer=8 expected=64 got=0` then subsequent `token repeat loop`.

sandeep: recommend steps:
1) rollback canary to previous quant profile (done?)
2) reproduce in staging with controlled traffic and perf counters
3) try weight-only AWQ (act_quant=false) at group_size 128 and group_size 64
4) enable per-layer debug logs for KV for 10k requests

maria: rollback initiated by deploy-bot: `deploy-bot: rollback initiated for awq-v2-canary-2026-06-03 -> awq-v1-stable` :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Rolling back 10% canary -> stable. ETA 2m.

maria: I'll run the staging matrix now. matrix: 
```yaml
- variant A: {group_size: 128, act_quant: true}
- variant B: {group_size: 128, act_quant: false}
- variant C: {group_size: 64, act_quant: true}
- variant D: {group_size: 32, act_quant: true}
- float_ref: {no quant}
```

alex: add a metric for token-repeat-rate and kv-serialization-errors. Also track per-layer activation variance.

eval-bot: queued evals:
- TriviaQA (1000 ex)
- summarization bench (200)
- synthetic repeat-burst test (500 prompts)

hao: note on deployment profile: when using Dedicated (reserved GPUs) memory fragmentation increases when group_size is small due to per-shard padding; might hit OOM if we go to 32 on 48GB GPUs. add headroom to autoscaler template.

sandeep: can we instrument a fast-check that rejects canary if token_repeat_rate > 0.3% or accuracy_delta < -1.0%?

maria: yes I'll add policy to rollout config: rollback on token_repeat_rate >= 0.3% OR accuracy_delta <= -1.0% on critical evals.

alex: if weight-only AWQ (act_quant=false) looks fine, that would be our safe default for serving while we debug act quant pipeline. Keep perf notes though: act_quant gives ~25% memory reduction.

maria: first staging results in 30m: 
- A (128,true): token_repeat_rate 0.45%, kv-errors 12/10k, accuracy_delta -1.1%
- B (128,false): token_repeat_rate 0.05%, kv-errors 0/10k, accuracy_delta -0.2%
- C (64,true): token_repeat_rate 0.12%, kv-errors 3/10k, accuracy_delta -0.5%
- D (32,true): OOM in warmup on 48GB (reproduced)

sandeep: that pretty clearly implicates act_quant. Looks like group_size helps but not enough.

maria: i'll prepare a targeted bug report for runtime team referencing PR #412 and include per-layer dumps for the failing traces. Also propose short-term: default canary profile = weight-only AWQ with group_size=128, investigate act-quant bug behind a link.

hao: can we also test a hybrid mode: act_quant only for first N layers disabled (e.g., first 6 layers full precision) and later layers quantized? Might reduce error. Worth a quick sweep.

alex: agree. add variants E/F: {act_quant_layers: [6..last], group_size:64} and {act_quant_layers: [8..last], group_size:128}.

maria: will run extended eval tomorrow, and post logs here. tagging @sandeep for priority. :pray:

sandeep: thanks. please include perf counters and a reproducible prompt set. I'll sync with runtime team on Monday.

eval-bot: results will be posted as new threads once runs complete.

maria: thanks all. rolling back fully and closing canary ticket for now. follow-ups: runtime PR link, per-layer dumps, hybrid sweep.

hao: ping me when you have dumps, I'll try to reproduce locally with the optimized kernel build.

maria: noted, attaching link to staging runs: https://redwood-internal/runs/awq-staging-1758003456

alex: :thumbsup:
